summary: Scorpio Gold Corp, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with a September 2, 2026 press release announcing Phase Two drill results at its Manhattan District Project in Nevada. The release details assay results from four holes, including high-grade gold intercepts such as 3.02 g/t gold over 48.92 meters in hole 26MN-115. It also notes 114 holes drilled totaling 32,585 meters, with assays pending on seven holes. This is an operational update on exploration progress and does not involve any corporate transaction or special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. Watch for future assay results from pending drill holes.
